MetricsScope.description: Represents a Metrics Scope (https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/settings#concept-scope) in Cloud Monitoring, which specifies one or more Google projects and zero or more AWS accounts to monitor together.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when this Metrics Scope was created.

monitoredProjects.description: Output only. The list of projects monitored by this Metrics Scope.

name.description: Immutable. The resource name of the Monitoring Metrics Scope. On input, the resource name can be specified with the scoping project ID or number. On output, the resource name is specified with the scoping project number. Example: locations/global/metricsScopes/{SCOPING_PROJECT_ID_OR_NUMBER}

updateTime.description: Output only. The time when this Metrics Scope record was last updated.

MonitoredProject.description: A project being monitored (https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/settings/multiple-projects#create-multi) by a Metrics Scope.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when this MonitoredProject was created.

isTombstoned.description: Output only. Set if the project has been tombstoned by the user.

name.description: Immutable. The resource name of the MonitoredProject. On input, the resource name includes the scoping project ID and monitored project ID. On output, it contains the equivalent project numbers. Example: locations/global/metricsScopes/{SCOPING_PROJECT_ID_OR_NUMBER}/projects/{MONITORED_PROJECT_ID_OR_NUMBER}

OperationMetadata.description: Contains metadata for longrunning operation for the edit Metrics Scope endpoints.

createTime.description: The time when the batch request was received.

state.description: Current state of the batch operation.

updateTime.description: The time when the operation result was last updated.
